links.comparator_used: Basic "simple" prompt without the enhanced instructions
links.outcome: Readability (Flesch-Kincaid Reading Ease), required reading level, and alignment with quality thresholds of ChatGPT-4 lay summaries of prostate cancer articles
links.effect: Median FKRE 40.9 vs 29.1 (p < 0.001); quality threshold alignment 86.2% vs 47.5% (p < 0.001); reduced required reading level; both prompts had median comprehensiveness Likert score of 5
links.quote: The extended prompt demonstrated significantly higher readability (median FKRE: 40.9 vs. 29.1, p < 0.001), better alignment with quality thresholds (86.2% vs. 47.5%, p < 0.001), and reduced the required reading level, making content more accessible.
